relations.subject: Hermann Georg Jacobi
relations.evidence: He was educated in the gymnasium of Cologne and then went to the University of Berlin, where initially he studied mathematics, but later... switched to Sanskrit and comparative linguistics

relations.subject: Hermann Georg Jacobi
relations.evidence: He obtained his doctorate from the University of Bonn. The subject of his thesis, written in 1872, was the origin of the term "hora" in Indian astrology.

relations.subject: Hermann Georg Jacobi
relations.evidence: The next year, with Georg Buehler, he visited Rajasthan, India, where manuscripts were being collected.

relations.subject: Hermann Georg Jacobi
relations.evidence: In 1875 he completed his habilitation and became a docent in Sanskrit at Bonn

relations.subject: Hermann Georg Jacobi
relations.role: professor extraordinarius of Sanskrit and Comparative Philology
relations.evidence: from 1876-85 he was professor extraordinarius of Sanskrit and Comparative Philology at Münster, Westphalia

relations.subject: Hermann Georg Jacobi
relations.evidence: in 1885, he was appointed professor ordinarius of Sanskrit at Kiel

relations.subject: Hermann Georg Jacobi
relations.evidence: in 1889 was appointed professor of Sanskrit at Bonn. He served as professor in Bonn until his retirement in 1922.
